evaluation_protocol.area_definition: COCO default original-image bbox area ranges, IoU 0.50:0.95
notes: COCO area evaluation on converted VisDrone labels, not official VisDrone ignore regions.
Ultralytics AP and COCO AP_all are separate evaluators/prediction passes; do not mix them.
Batch val may use rectangular padding; area predict uses each 4-image chunk padding.
P/R are Ultralytics selected F1 operating point metrics, not P/R at conf=0.001.
Training built-in validation may use FP16 and double batch; final report is standalone FP32.

p2_architecture.variant: E5a existing-method control: standard DySample replaces only original neck layers 11 and 14; P3->P2 nearest upsampling and all E1 P2 structure remain unchanged
p2_architecture.novelty_claim: none; E5a is a required existing-method mechanism control
p2_architecture.profile_note: THOP may not count grid_sample interpolation arithmetic; always report measured latency too.
p2_architecture.determinism_note: PyTorch 2.5.1 CUDA grid_sample backward has no deterministic implementation. Full TAL loss/gradient equivalence is therefore checked on CPU; smoke2 verifies real CUDA training. Accuracy claims require multi-seed confirmation if E5a is retained.
p2_architecture.fairness: Frozen E1 P2-C3k2 and complete Detect initialization copied tensor-for-tensor.

preflight_transfer.source: original 80-class yolo11s.pt; never an experiment best.pt
preflight_transfer.initialization_note: Only DySample tensors are new. Shared tensors come from yolo11s.pt; E1 P2-C3k2 and complete Detect tensors are copied from the deterministic E1 seed-1 reference.

matching_equivalence.limits: Synthetic FP32-GT cases and batch8 real-model 128px steps; not a 1024px memory test or a guarantee of identical final AP.

smoke_gate.note: Two full training epochs + builtin validation + full FP32/area evaluation. Not an accuracy result.

training.memory_note: PyTorch allocator peaks, including in-training validation; not whole-device usage.
training.comparison_note: Full forward batch unchanged; image-wise matching only. Training time/memory comparisons require the same matching implementation on both models.

pretrained_transfer.source: original 80-class yolo11s.pt; never an experiment best.pt
pretrained_transfer.initialization_note: Only DySample tensors are new. Shared tensors come from yolo11s.pt; E1 P2-C3k2 and complete Detect tensors are copied from the deterministic E1 seed-1 reference.

validation.speed_note: Batched FP32 validation, NOT batch=1 deployment FPS.
